from manim import *
import numpy as np

class Section1Scene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # 1. Setup Layout (Title and Lecture Notes)
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        title_text = "The Triangle of Power: Unified Notation"
        lecture_lines = [
            "- Connects Powers, Roots, and Logs",
            "- Visual representation of $x^y = z$",
            "- High mathematical symmetry",
            "- Simplified algebraic manipulation"
        ]

        title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(title)

        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        lecture_group = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        lecture_group.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(lecture_group, shift=RIGHT))

        # 2. Define 6x6 Animation Grid (Right Side)
        grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]
        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                # Offset grid to the right half of the screen
                x = 1.5 + j * 0.9 
                y = 1.8 - i * 0.9
                grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

        # 3. Create the Triangle of Power
        # Vertices: Top (Exponent), Bottom-Left (Base), Bottom-Right (Result)
        top_v = grid["B3"]
        left_v = grid["E1"]
        right_v = grid["E5"]

        triangle = Polygon(top_v, left_v, right_v, color=BLUE, stroke_width=4)
        
        # Labels using MathTex and tex_to_color_map for consistency (Belief B050)
        label_base = MathTex("b", tex_to_color_map={"b": YELLOW}).move_to(left_v + LEFT * 0.4)
        label_exp = MathTex("e", tex_to_color_map={"e": RED}).move_to(top_v + UP * 0.4)
        label_val = MathTex("v", tex_to_color_map={"v": GREEN}).move_to(right_v + RIGHT * 0.4)

        # 4. Animation Sequence
        self.play(Create(triangle), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(
            Write(label_base),
            Write(label_exp),
            Write(label_val)
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # 5. Show Relationships
        # Power: b^e = v
        eq_power = MathTex("b^e = v", tex_to_color_map={"b": YELLOW, "e": RED, "v": GREEN})
        eq_power.move_to(grid["F3"])
        
        # Create arrows pointing to relationships
        side_left = Line(top_v, left_v, color=RED_A)
        side_right = Line(top_v, right_v, color=GREEN_A)
        side_bottom = Line(left_v, right_v, color=YELLOW_A)

        self.play(side_bottom.animate.set_stroke(width=8), Write(eq_power))
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(side_bottom.animate.set_stroke(width=4))

        # Root: e_root_v = b
        eq_root = MathTex("\\sqrt[e]{v} = b", tex_to_color_map={"b": YELLOW, "e": RED, "v": GREEN})
        eq_root.move_to(grid["F3"])
        
        self.play(
            ReplacementTransform(eq_power, eq_root),
            side_left.animate.set_stroke(width=8)
        )
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(side_left.animate.set_stroke(width=4))

        # Log: log_b(v) = e
        eq_log = MathTex("\\log_b(v) = e", tex_to_color_map={"b": YELLOW, "e": RED, "v": GREEN})
        eq_log.move_to(grid["F3"])

        self.play(
            ReplacementTransform(eq_root, eq_log),
            side_right.animate.set_stroke(width=8)
        )
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(side_right.animate.set_stroke(width=4))

        # Final cleanup
        self.play(FadeOut(eq_log), triangle.animate.set_fill(BLUE, opacity=0.2))
        self.wait(2)
